newsitem.title: USA: GAO finds faulty bookeeping in Fed branch - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: GAO finds faulty bookeeping in Fed branch - WSJ.

text.p: The General Accounting Office (GAO) found accounting problems and irregularities in cash reporting at the Los Angeles branch of the San Francisco Federal Reserve Bank, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.

The GAO, the investigative arm of Congress, did not say cash was missing, but faulted the bank's "inability to precisely summarize currency activity from its cash inventory records", the article said.
The newspaper said the Federal Reserve Board in Washington found no problems with the cash accounting at the Los Angeles bank following its own review of the situation.
